mini_games.name: Speed Math
mini_games.objective: Solve a rapid mental arithmetic problem before the timer expires.
detailed_rules: A math equation containing 2 or 3 operations is displayed on screen.
The player must calculate the result mentally without pen, paper, or calculator.
The player must submit the exact numerical answer before time runs out.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Large centered equation text, remaining time bar, numerical keypad / input box.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Randomly generate operand A (1-50), operator (+, -, *), and operand B (1-20). Ensure clean integer outputs (no fractional divisions).
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Compare user input against evaluated equation value (e.g., input === eval(A + op + B)).

mini_games.notes: Keep numbers manageable for mental calculation within 5 seconds.

mini_games.name: Rhyme Challenge
mini_games.objective: Provide 2 valid rhyming words for a given target word.
detailed_rules: A base target word is shown to the player.
The player must speak aloud 2 distinct words that share the same ending phonetic rhyme.
Other players judge whether the words are valid rhymes.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Target word displayed in bold card, audio timer sound effect, 'Pass' and 'Fail' buttons for peers.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Select randomly from a curated list of common rhythmic words.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Peer review: other players click 'Success' or 'Fail'.

mini_games.notes: Slang or regional accents should be agreed upon before starting.

mini_games.name: SHORT Reverse Word
mini_games.objective: Spell or pronounce a 3-to-4 letter word in reverse order.
detailed_rules: A short word (3-4 characters) is revealed.
The player must immediately spell out its letters from end to beginning.
No pauses or self-corrections allowed.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Word card centered, countdown timer, text input field or verbal pass/fail buttons.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Pick a word with length between 3 and 4 characters from a dictionary.

mini_games.notes: Limit strictly to 3 or 4 letters to keep it within the 4-second window.

mini_games.name: FAST Stop Bus Complete
mini_games.objective: Name one valid item belonging to a single category starting with a specified letter.
detailed_rules: The screen presents one category (e.g., Animal, Country, Plant) and one letter.
The player must shout out one valid item starting with that letter within 5 seconds.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Two prominent badges: [Category] and [Letter], 5s visual progress bar, Pass/Fail triggers.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Randomly select 1 category from a pool and 1 valid letter from the alphabet.

mini_games.notes: Avoid rare letters like (ظ / ذ / X / Q) in the Easy tier.

mini_games.name: Word Ban
mini_games.objective: Answer a prompt or talk continuously for 10 seconds without uttering a banned letter or word.
detailed_rules: The screen displays a prompt question and a 'BANNED' constraint (a specific letter or word).
The player must speak continuously to answer the prompt for 10 full seconds.
Using the banned letter/word or stopping for more than 2 seconds results in immediate failure.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Prompt text at top, high-visibility red badge for banned item, live 10-second countdown bar, buzzer button for peers.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Pair an open-ended conversational prompt with a high-frequency letter (e.g., 'م', 'ر', 'A') or word ('نعم', 'لا', 'Yes').
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Peers press 'Buzzer/Fail' if the banned rule is broken; otherwise 'Pass' auto-triggers at 0s.

examples.prompt: احكي عملت إيه أول ما صحيت النهاردة؟

mini_games.notes: Ensure opponents actively listen to catch slipped letters.

mini_games.name: Odd One Out
mini_games.objective: Identify the single item among 4 options that does not share the common classification trait.
detailed_rules: A 2x2 grid of 4 items (words, numbers, or icons) is displayed.
3 items belong to a specific group/pattern; 1 item is unrelated.
Player clicks the odd item directly.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: 2x2 clickable grid of cards with words or images.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Select 1 pre-configured dataset containing: 3 matched items, 1 odd item, and the target index.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Check if clicked button index matches `correct_index`.

mini_games.notes: Can use simple icons or text for rapid cross-platform rendering.

mini_games.name: Common Questions (Logic / Deduction)
mini_games.objective: Solve a 1-to-2 line logical comparison question.
detailed_rules: A short comparative scenario is presented (e.g., height, speed, or weight ranking).
The player must select the correct entity answering the final question.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Prompt card with question text, 3 to 4 multiple-choice buttons below.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Template-based logic: A > B, C < B. Query highest (A) or lowest (C).
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Verify selected option index against pre-computed answer.

examples.question: سارة أطول من ندى، ومي أقصر من ندى. مين أطول واحدة؟
Car A is faster than Car B. Car C is slower than Car B. Which is slowest?

mini_games.notes: Keep text concise so reading time does not exceed 3 seconds.

mini_games.name: Last Letter Word Chain
mini_games.objective: Form a 3-word sequence where each consecutive word begins with the final letter of the preceding word.
detailed_rules: A starter word is given on screen.
The player must speak 2 more words in sequence, each starting with the last letter of the previous one.
All words must be real, meaningful words.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Starter word badge, 2 empty slot placeholders, 6s countdown.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Select random starter word ending with a common letter.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Peers confirm validity and correct letter linkages.

mini_games.notes: No repeated words allowed in the same chain.

mini_games.name: Common Letter Finder
mini_games.objective: Identify the single character present in all 4 displayed words.
detailed_rules: 4 words are displayed simultaneously.
Exactly one letter exists in every single word.
The player inputs or selects the common letter.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: 4 word pills arranged horizontally or in a column, on-screen alphabet row or direct text input.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Select target letter L, pick 4 dictionary words containing L, verify that `intersection(letters(w1), letters(w2), letters(w3), letters(w4)) == {L}`.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Check if user selected letter === L.

mini_games.notes: Algorithm must verify no second accidental common letter exists.

mini_games.name: Tongue Twisters
mini_games.objective: Repeat a difficult phrase 3 times rapidly without stumbling or mispronouncing.
detailed_rules: A classic tongue twister appears on the screen.
The player must recite it 3 full times back-to-back at high speed.
Any stammer, syllable inversion, or extended pause is an instant failure.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: 'RARE CHALLENGE' highlighted banner, large clear font of the phrase, repetition counter (1/3, 2/3, 3/3), Pass/Fail peer buttons.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Set spawn probability weight low (e.g., 5-10% chance in Hard pool) to keep it rare and fun.

mini_games.notes: Flagged as 'Rare' in game configuration for maximum entertainment value.

mini_games.name: HARD Stop Bus Complete
mini_games.objective: Name items across 3 distinct categories starting with the designated letter.
detailed_rules: A single letter is displayed along with 3 required categories (e.g., Person, Country, Object).
The player must state one valid answer for each category within 10 seconds.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Large letter in circle, 3 category badges (e.g., [اسم], [بلد], [جماد]), 10s radial countdown timer, peer judgment buttons.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Pick a letter with rich vocabulary (e.g., م, س, ك, ب, ف) and 3 standard categories.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: Peers verify all 3 answers match the letter and respective categories.

mini_games.notes: Do not use difficult letters (ظ / ذ / Q / Z) for 3-category challenges.

mini_games.name: Fitness Physical Challenges
mini_games.objective: Perform a short physical exercise rep count or isometric hold.
detailed_rules: A specific exercise and target count/duration are displayed.
The player leaves their seat and completes the physical requirement within the allotted time.
Form must be clean according to fellow players.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Exercise illustration / icon, target count in large text, animated timer bar with audio ticks, 'Completed' and 'Failed' buttons.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Select randomly from a list of bodyweight exercises suitable for indoor board game spaces.

mini_games.notes: Ensure safety and accommodate physical space around the table.

mini_games.name: Stroop Effect
mini_games.objective: Correctly identify font ink colors under conflicting semantic word conditions.
detailed_rules: 4 color words are shown on screen, but each word is rendered in a conflicting font color (e.g., the word 'RED' printed in Blue ink).
Mode A (Verbal): Player must recite the 4 INK COLORS aloud from left to right (ignoring what is written).
Mode B (Interactive): Player must click the single card where Font Color matches Text Meaning.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Row of 4 colored text elements with randomized `color` CSS attributes mismatched with string values.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Generate 4 words from ['Red', 'Blue', 'Green', 'Yellow']. Assign font colors such that text != color, except for 1 match if using Mode B.
ui_and_logic_design.validation_logic: If Mode B: click matches true color-text pair. If Mode A: peer validates verbal output.

mini_games.notes: Highly demanding on cognitive inhibition; strict 4-second time limit.

mini_games.name: Double Constraint Word
mini_games.objective: Produce a valid word that satisfies two simultaneous morphological or lexical rules.
detailed_rules: Two distinct rules appear on screen (e.g., Start Letter + End Letter, or Category + Character Count).
The player must state one valid word that meets both criteria before the timer runs out.

ui_and_logic_design.layout: Two distinct highlighted condition pills (Condition 1 | Condition 2), timer bar, peer validation triggers.
ui_and_logic_design.generation_logic: Pick paired constraints guaranteed to have at least 3 valid solutions in the target language.

mini_games.notes: Avoid impossible combinations; verify solution space beforehand.
